title: Improve Lueftungssysteme Animations
summary: Rewrote Cooling/6 scene_6.py so every beat animates a measurable quantity instead of fading in badges, and added SAFE_TOP/SAFE_BOTTOM zones plus a _fit_band guard that removes the label-on-room-outline collisions verified in the baseline render. Then inserted a three-beat mechanical-ventilation block between night purge and the summary — limits of free ventilation, the three base types, and plate heat recovery with the Phi formula — rebuilding the animations deleted by PASSIVE-NATURAL-VENT on the current template. Hand-broke all 32 auto-shrunk captions so caption size is uniform. Nine beats render clean over five manim -ql passes with frame readback; audio regeneration deliberately left to the dev.
